items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel
items.claim: The LORD heard the murmurings of the children of Israel
items.object: murmurings of the children of Israel

items.claim: Moses is directed to speak to the children of Israel

items.quote: At even ye shall eat flesh
items.claim: The children of Israel will eat flesh in the evening

items.quote: in the morning ye shall be filled with bread
items.claim: The children of Israel will be filled with bread in the morning

items.quote: ye shall know that I am the LORD your God
items.claim: The children of Israel will know that the LORD is their God
items.object: that I am the LORD your God
